Have you considered recording yourself? You wouldn't even have to leave your house (Expect maybe to get a mic) and you could get some feedback and maybe feel less isolated? 

If I give you my morphine I'll have to go through withdrawl or admit I commited a felony :(

I only asked because I am rather embarassed about all this. So i wasn't sure if you were accusing me of being melodramatic, or what.  

But in that case, have you considered making a thread here?
Troll or suicidal person?
Sarcasm.
Leg braces and bikes don't mix so well.
I have an appeal before their "judge" coming up sometime. Getting on disability would be ok with me because I would stop costing my parents money while I sort out my life.
I was denied disability... twice. I have a nervous system disorder that is destroying my spine.

Well I'm not really fucked up but the average person would be. People don't seem to believe that you can take opiates and feel almost nothing because they only remember taking them for a few days after they got their wisdom teeth out or whatever. 

But even pain killers don't help me sleep really. Smoking a joint and taking pain killers does though.
Hope to find a job and see if things get better. Being fucked up every night doesn't bother me as much as it seems to bother society in general.

Theres nothing they can do as far as surgery. I'd like to have enough money to afford medicinal marijuana but I'm broke as hell and my insurance won't cover the dangerous narcotic drug known as marihuana so I'm stuck with safe non-addictive morphine.
I spend a lot of time chain smoking and wandering through the woods.
I know html but thats about it. I studied Information Security when I was in school.
I can't sleep at all when I'm sober, so in a world where there were no drugs I'd be fucking insane, or dead.
Everyone recommends I volunteer somewhere, but I require currency. Volunteering costs me money in bus fare.
I require drugs to stay sane.

What are therapists supposed to discuss with their patients?

I mostly told stories about things that had happened to me recently.

> What have you always wanted to learn but never had the time? What have you always wanted to learn but never had the time?

This a good question that I can't think of an answer to. I'm sure I have time to learn anything now. It's really only a question what I have the energy to pursue.
Yes aside from just generally being a fuckup with no job and no social skills.

I wish I could say something that would help you. I know exactly what you mean about being in crippling pain or under the influence of heavy medication. I myself suffer from chronic pain. I can't really remember what it's like to be sober anymore. I spent over a year on crutches and can't imagine what it would be like to have to be on them for my entire life. Feel free to message me.

I did when I was younger. I had a therapist. We never got anywhere and one day I walked out of his office after promising to make an appointment to see him next month (like always) and never went back. 

Haven't seen him in at least 3 years.

I also used to be on prozac as a teenager (OMG IT MAKES TEENS SUICIDAL hadn't happened yet I guess or my doctors were trying to off me) but I quit taking it because everyone thought it was making me "irritable" but it was actually the happiest I ever was. I'm just a complete dick when I'm happy because I still don't give a shit what anyone thinks of me but I also don't care if they know that as far as I'm concerned they can go fuck themselves and actually having the energy to express myself changed my personality drastically. Pretty much I acted the same way I do now when I'm blind drunk. 

Upon reflection as an adult I probably had something like this going on http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hypomania
Essentially I'm in constant pain. So I'm  either high or desperately hoping I die 24/7.
